garden: Hollyhock Lane Community Garden, Marrow Valley

plants.name: tomato
plants.note: Harden off for a week before moving outside.

plants.name: pepper
plants.note: Wait for warm nights; peppers stall below 13C.

plants.name: basil
plants.note: Pinch the flower buds to keep leaves coming.

plants.name: lettuce
plants.note: Cool-season crop; sow again every two weeks.

plants.name: peas
plants.note: Direct sow as soon as the soil can be worked.

plants.name: carrot
plants.note: Direct sow only; keep the seedbed damp until they sprout.

plants.name: zucchini
plants.note: One plant feeds a family; give it a full square metre.

plants.name: cucumber
plants.note: Trellis it to save space and keep fruit clean.

plants.name: kale
plants.note: Sweetens after the first autumn frost.

plants.name: garlic
plants.note: Plant cloves in October; harvest when the lower leaves brown.

plants.name: sunflower
plants.note: Stake the tall varieties against wind.

plants.name: dahlia
plants.note: Lift the tubers after the first hard frost.
